component.name: AR Files
component.summary: Cloud-native desktop file manager for Fedora and GNOME

description.p: AR Files is a high-performance desktop file manager designed for Fedora Workstation and GNOME. It combines the native Libadwaita aesthetic of GNOME Files with an asynchronous, local-first cloud storage architecture.

ul.li: Local-first SQLite metadata engine with FTS5 instant search: browsing never blocks or freezes on slow network mounts.
Sparse placeholder files: preview entire multi-terabyte cloud drives occupying zero local disk blocks.
On-demand hydration: stream files directly into applications upon open with resumable chunked downloads.
Smart cache management: LRU disk cache eviction with customizable storage budgets and offline file pinning.
FUSE virtual filesystem: mount cloud namespaces seamlessly to any terminal or standard desktop utility.
Adwaita symbolic emblems: real-time visual indicators for sync, pin, hydration progress, and conflict status.

screenshot.caption: Browser view showing cloud placeholders and sync indicators

description.p: Initial release of AR Files featuring local-first metadata, virtual list browsing, FUSE integration, and Google Drive / OneDrive support.
